# sheet-music — Lead Sheet Transcription & Docx Reformatting

The `sheet-music` skill converts scanned lead sheet PDFs in Dropbox into clean, professional Word (`.docx`) lead sheets stored back in Dropbox.
Processing scanned PDF file: ~/Dropbox/joshandmariamusic/Mission/Narthex.pdf...
Transcribing lyrics and chord alignment.
Output saved to: ~/Dropbox/joshandmariamusic/Mission/Narthex.docx
